Role: Frontend owner.

You may edit only:
- src/** (React/Vite app)
- public/** (static files)

Do NOT edit:
- server.js, supabase/**, utils/**, or root configs (vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json, eslint.config.js, tailwind.config.js).
  If a tiny config tweak is required, leave a TODO and describe it in the PR instead of changing it.

Goals:
- Production-ready UI: accessible labels/aria, keyboard support, mobile-friendly layout,
  no console errors, clean component/state boundaries.

Backend/data missing:
- Add a TODO and write what endpoint/shape is needed; don’t stub complex backend logic.

PR must include: summary, screenshots/GIF, testing steps, and any TODOs for area:backend.
